steps: Boil water in a pot
Add cumin seeds
Simmer for 5-7 minutes
Strain and drink warm
Boil water in a pot
Add coriander seeds
Simmer for 5-7 minutes
Strain and drink warm
Boil water in a pot
Add tulsi leaves
Simmer for 3-5 minutes
Strain and drink warm
Boil water
Add bay leaves
Simmer for 5 minutes
Strain and serve warm
Boil water
Add vitex berries
Steep for 5-7 minutes
Strain and serve warm
Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves
Add diced onions, sauté until golden
Add carrots and peas, cook for 2 minutes
Dry roast vermicelli in a separate pan
Add roasted vermicelli to vegetables
Cook for 3-4 minutes, stirring continuously
Season with salt and serve hot
Mix semolina with yogurt and let sit for 10 minutes
Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves
Add green chili, pour into semolina mixture
Add coconut and salt, mix well
Pour batter into greased idli moulds (3/4 full)
Steam for 8-10 minutes
Cool slightly and remove from moulds
Roast millet and moong dal separately
Cook in pressure cooker with 4 cups water (2 whistles)
Heat ghee, add peppercorns and cumin seeds
Add onions, ginger, green chilies, sauté well
Add cashews and methi leaves
Mix with cooked millet and dal
Season with salt and serve hot
Mix all flours with yogurt to form a smooth batter
Add green chili and ginger
Season with salt
Heat a non-stick pan, pour batter and spread thin
Cook until edges turn golden
Flip and cook the other side
Serve hot with chutney
Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves
Add onions and green chili, sauté well
Add carrots and peas, cook for 2 minutes
Add oats and 2 cups water
Cook stirring occasionally until water is absorbed
Season with salt and pepper
Serve hot
Dry roast jowar until fragrant
Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves
Add onions, carrots, peas and green chili
Add roasted jowar and 2 cups water
Cook covered until jowar is tender
Stir and break any lumps
Season with salt and serve hot
Heat ghee, add bay leaves, cinnamon, cloves
Add onions and ginger, sauté until golden
Add remaining vegetables, cook for 2 minutes
Add rice and 2 cups water
Cook covered until rice is tender
Fluff with a fork and serve hot
Rinse millet thoroughly
Heat ghee, add vegetables and cook for 1 minute
Add millet and roast for 2 minutes
Add 3 cups water
Cook covered until millet becomes soft and porridge-like
Season with salt and pepper
Stir well and serve hot
Cook rice in water until soft
Cut okra into pieces, sprinkle salt and keep aside
Heat oil, add mustard and cumin seeds
Add onion, ginger, and green chili
Add okra and cook without covering (to avoid sliminess)
Add turmeric powder and salt
Cook for 5-7 minutes until okra is tender
Mix with cooked rice and serve
Soak moong dal and quinoa for 30 minutes
Heat ghee, sauté onions and carrots
Add soaked moong dal and quinoa
Add 3 cups water
Cook covered until both are tender (15-20 minutes)
Season with salt and pepper
Stir well and serve hot
Boil water with salt
Slowly add ragi flour, stirring to avoid lumps
Cook until thick (5-7 minutes)
Shape into balls and place on a plate
Heat oil, add mustard seeds and curry leaves
Add onion, green chili, and agathi leaves
Cook for 3-4 minutes until leaves are tender
Serve ragi balls with agathi bhaji
Heat ghee, add cumin seeds and green chili
Add onions and sauté until soft
Add carrots and peas, cook for 2 minutes
Add broken wheat and 2.5 cups water
Cook covered until wheat is tender and water is absorbed
Season with salt
Stir well and serve hot
Make a batter with moong dal flour and water (thin consistency)
Add grated lauki, onion, green chili, and ginger
Season with salt
Heat oil on a non-stick pan
Pour batter and spread to make a thin crepe
Cook until golden on both sides
Serve hot with chutney

ingredients: For appe: 1 cup rice flour, mixed vegetables, oil
steps: For soup: Heat oil, sauté onion and ginger
Add tomatoes and cook until soft
Blend into smooth paste, strain and cook
For appe: Make a thick batter with rice flour
Heat appe mould, add oil, pour batter
Add mixed vegetables, cook until golden
Serve soup hot with veggie appe
Heat oil, sauté onion and ginger until golden
Add mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes
Add drumstick pieces and 4 cups water
Cook until drumstick is tender (10-12 minutes)
Crush slightly to release flavors
Season with salt and pepper
Garnish with coriander and serve hot

ingredients: 1 cup dried chickpeas (chana), soaked and boiled
steps: Boil soaked chickpeas until soft
In a bowl, mix boiled chana with diced vegetables
Add fresh coriander and green chili
Season with lemon juice, chaat masala, and salt
Mix well and serve immediately
Dry roast almonds and cashews in a pan for 2-3 minutes
In another pan, dry roast sunflower seeds for 2 minutes
Roast pumpkin seeds and sesame seeds separately
Cool all ingredients completely
Mix together and store in an airtight container
Portion as needed for snacking
Heat ghee in a pan on medium heat
Add makhana gradually
Stir continuously to prevent burning
Roast until golden and crispy (5-7 minutes)
Season with salt and spices if desired
Spread on paper towel to cool
Store in airtight container
Spread peanuts on a baking tray
Roast in oven at 350°F for 10-12 minutes, stirring occasionally
Or dry roast in a pan for 8-10 minutes on medium heat
Cool completely
Rub between hands to remove skin (optional)
Season with salt
Store in airtight container
Bring water to boil in a pot
Gently place eggs in boiling water
For soft-boiled: 4-5 minutes
For medium-boiled: 7-8 minutes
For hard-boiled: 10-12 minutes
Transfer to ice water immediately
Peel and enjoy
In a bowl, mix puffed rice and roasted peanuts
Add finely diced onion and green chili
Season with lemon juice and salt
Mix thoroughly
Garnish with coriander
Serve immediately
Wash sweet potatoes thoroughly
Prick with fork to allow steam to escape
Bake in oven at 400°F for 40-50 minutes
Or microwave for 8-10 minutes
Check with fork if soft inside
Cut in half, scoop out flesh
Season with salt and enjoy
Wash okra and pat dry thoroughly
Cut into medium pieces
Heat oil, add mustard seeds and green chili
Add onion, dice into fine pieces
Add okra pieces carefully
Add turmeric and chili powder
Cook on high heat without covering (to prevent sliminess)
Add tomato and cook for 5-7 minutes
Season with salt
Serve hot
